reviews.title: Quality RGB Gaming RAM
reviews.comment: This is good quality gaming RAM with pretty RGB. Buy it! Though not guaranteed or advertised to push to 6500 MTs, I got it there. Paired with : 9800x3D RTX 5090 MSI Tomahawk x870e
reviews.author: DadiGamer

reviews.title: Good
reviews.comment: It's adequate and does the job without any problem fits perfectly highly recommended not too expensive
reviews.author: Dr Julian

reviews.title: Great RAM, compatible with
reviews.comment: Great DDR5 RAM, works flawlessly (It is on QVL list) with my Ryzen 9900X CPU and Gigabyte X870E Aorus Elite WiFi 7. RGB is a nice bonus on it.
reviews.author: Darko Krišan

reviews.title: DDR 5 6400 that lives up to the hype!
reviews.comment: Blazing fast and easily overclocked although.... there's no need. RGB lighting is cool too if you're into that! Packed well and fair price!
reviews.author: erich brinkerhoff

reviews.title: Muy buen producto (Solo es compatible con Intel XMP)
reviews.comment: Un producto muy bueno, sin embargo, no le doy las 5 estrellas ya que me encontré con la sorpresa de que no soportan AMD Expo, solo Intel XMP, sería buena idea actualizar la descripción del producto para ser claros con esto. Sin embargo, mi motherboard me permitió activar ese perfil XMP con un procesador AMD, y estoy obteniendo la velocidad de 6400 MT/s de manera estable, sin ningún problema. También fue necesario actualizar la bios.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
